<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>胆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>怯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>兢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guān</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>尚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>阵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>尚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>阵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>聘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pìn</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>尚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>阵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guān</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>胆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>怯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>化<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guān</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>率<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuài</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>睦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>睦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>效<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>付<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>男<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>丁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dīnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lüè</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>淋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>漓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>雨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>滴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dī</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>露<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>雨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>嫩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèn</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>甘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>霖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>蔬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>德<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>伪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>乖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuāi</rt></ruby><ruby>僻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pì</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>曲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>邪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby><ruby>僻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>弊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>历<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>；<ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>疆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>份<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>吼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>环<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huán</rt></ruby><ruby>绕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>瞳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>搅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>巢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cháo</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>雏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>搧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>展<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>雏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>翼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。
